## Change

Describe the problem, a concrete trigger, and the resulting behavior. Link a relevant issue if one exists.

## Verification

List checks actually run and the environment. For measurement changes, explain how tokens and timing cover the same output. For UI changes, include synthetic screenshots.

## Limitations

Describe unverified platforms, formats, or known limitations; delete this section if none apply.

Please keep real logs, titles, paths, credentials, and local databases out of the PR.
